verdict.Q1: NO parity-odd O(h^2) operator in minimal ECH + Dirac/Weyssenhoff spin fluid
verdict.Q2: coefficient identically zero; a nonzero one needs a dynamical Immirzi/Nieh-Yan pseudoscalar (ad-hoc w.r.t. the minimal model)
verdict.Q3: Delta_h = O(k eta_B) -> <= 1e-12 (LISA), 1e-17 (PTA), 1e-27 (CMB) even at the unitarity ceiling
verdict.Q4: every band needs Delta_h = O(1); short by >=12 orders of magnitude
verdict.gate: CLOSE WITH REASON (O(epsilon), and requires an ad-hoc ingredient)

convention_flags: Holst sign s_H is not fixed by the lab's artifacts; both signs flip O4's sign only.
The ECH note fixes gamma^2/(1+gamma^2) but no committed numerical rho_c / T_B: a two-point range (1e16 GeV, M_Pl) is scanned instead of inventing one.
C = O(1) matching constant is set to its maximum (1.0); it is model-dependent and is NOT computed here.
xi_B is bounded above by perturbative unitarity, not derived from ECH (in minimal ECH it is exactly 0).
